concept.palette_reason: The materials and working lights in metal sleeping ledges inside a giant stone crushing lift supply these colors.

signature.danger: The lift closes its stone jaws whenever the climbing teeth stop moving.
signature.rule: Climb above the painted jaw line before the teeth stop.
signature.cost: The painted safety line rises after every closure, forcing you permanently higher.
signature.anomaly: The quarry teeth leave bite marks in empty air.
signature.inhabitants: Other climbers signal safe ledges by tapping their tools.

causal_logic.danger_origin: Metal sleeping ledges inside a giant stone crushing lift. The lift closes its stone jaws whenever the climbing teeth stop moving.
causal_logic.rule_protection: Climb above the painted jaw line before the teeth stop. This keeps you outside the failure described here: The jaws close across the lower sleeping ledges.
causal_logic.failure_consequence: The jaws close across the lower sleeping ledges.
causal_logic.cost_origin: The painted safety line rises after every closure, forcing you permanently higher.
causal_logic.reason_to_choose: You collect edible roots exposed by the lift’s climbing teeth. You sleep on a ledge that clears the marked jaw line.

narration: Your shelter sits inside a quarry lift.
Roots grow between its climbing teeth.
The jaws close whenever the teeth stop.
Climb above the painted line first.
